_notes._about: Zalo Desktop 26.11 (snapshot 2026-11-20) -> zalors shadow, written from the --inventory names/types ONLY (batch 13). Every field whose meaning could not be derived from names/types is marked here; batch 14 adds a whitelisted distinct-values tool to settle the code columns.
_notes.msgType: LEFT EMPTY BY DESIGN: Core/Message/*.db 'message' table stores msgType as INTEGER (numeric Desktop codes) whose meanings are not derivable from names/types. Pass-through keeps messages.type=100 (the honest unknown bucket) until the codes are mapped to web msgType strings by the batch-14 tool.
_notes.entities.message.columns.msgId: message.msgId is TEXT and the table's pk, matching the capture envelope name exactly; cliMsgId is the client id, carried as an extra envelope field. Confidence: name-match only, not value-verified.
_notes.entities.message.columns.ts: ts reads serverTime (declared TEXT) as epoch ms (ms_to_ms), chosen by the probe's shape-only comparison: sendDttm agreed 188/263 on matches (per-conv clusters -> sender's device clock), serverTime agreed 253/265 on the same picks. Residual 12/265 ts disagreements (concentrated in 2 conversations) are open for the batch-14 distinct-values tool; sendDttm (client clock) and originTs remain the documented alternatives.
_notes.entities.message.columns.msgType_consequ: With msgType unmapped every row lands kind=100, so content_json will NOT parse media JSON-text into objects (MEDIA_CODES exclude 100): media 'message' JSON would stay a string and, on a future apply, could fill a NULL text cell with JSON text. Resolve with the code mapping before any apply step (2.5).
_notes.entities.message.columns.content: Chose the 'message' column (the per-kind Index.db tables image/file/link also carry 'message' as the content blob, so it is read as the wire-content column). Alternatives: 'content', 'msgText'.
_notes.entities.message.columns.uidFrom: fromUid read as the sender. Self-sent rows may store '0' (capture-path convention -> sender NULL, conv from idTo) or the real own uid (-> conv would become the own uid for 1-1; the probe's per-conv counts expose this).
_notes.entities.message.columns.idTo: toUid read directly. If the probe shows one2one/group conv misses, the documented fix is {"const":"$db_id"} on idTo (the DB file-name digits ARE the conversation id).
_notes.entities.message.db: stranger is included although the stranger_box sample has 0 rows (same schema as the other message DBs).
_notes.entities.conversation: Index.db 'conversation' has no title/avatar/last_ts columns; nothing is mapped for them. lastSmsLocalId is deliberately NOT mapped to last_msg_id: it is a LOCAL id, not a server msgId, and would poison conversations.last_msg_id.
_notes.entities.contact: Index.db has both 'friend' (775 rows) and 'friends_info' (638 rows, superset schema with friendRequest* columns); 'friend' is read as the live contact list.
_notes.entities.group.columns.group_id: The 'group' table's pk is NAMED userId but is read as the GROUP id (the g<id>.db file-name digits / shadow conv id for groups).
